about: Mutants in ci/mutants/*.json whose `from` no longer resolves exactly once in its file (or whose file is gone), as measured on master 5b19c609c7, 2026-11-23: 45 of 849 mutants, in 18 of 82 manifests. Each would mutate nothing if run. This is a DEBT list, owed by each manifest's author, and it ONLY SHRINKS: give the mutant the `from` and `to` of the file's current text, run it with tools/ci_mutant_runner.py, and remove its id here. No new entry is ever added (tools/ci_mutant_manifests.py, tests/test_ci_mutant_manifests.py). To see what is wrong with each: python tools/ci_mutant_manifests.py --list
